class Counter { get value() { return 2; } }
const counted = { ...new Counter() };
console.log(counted.value);
class Pair { v = 1; get value() { return 2; } set value(x: number) {} }
const paired = { ...new Pair() };
console.log(paired.value);
class Base { v = 1; #secret = 2; get doubled() { return this.v * 2; } method() { return this.#secret; } }
class Derived extends Base { w = 3; }
const derived = { ...new Derived() };
console.log(derived.v, derived.w);
console.log(derived.doubled);
interface WithGetter { get size(): number; }
const sized: WithGetter = { get size() { return 4; } };
const sizedCopy = { ...sized };
console.log(sizedCopy.size);
const literal = { get n() { return 5; } };
const literalCopy = { ...literal };
console.log(literalCopy.n);
const both = { ...new Derived(), ...literal };
const notNumber: number = both;
console.log(notNumber);
